clusters.name: After grandfather's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Your mother's anxiety rose over money in early 1988, and around May she and your father stopped talking about it. Your grandfather died in July 1989. Within months, your brother's grades fell, and your mother's anxiety eased once she returned to work in early 1990. The pile of events around your grandfather's death and its aftermath sits in the middle of this stretch.

clusters.name: After your mother's cancer diagnosis, 1994–1996
clusters.reason: You left for college in September 1993. By March 1994 you had migraines keeping you in bed, and you called your brother most nights. Your mother was told she had breast cancer in February 1995. Within months you stopped returning your brother's calls and then stopped calling home. The shifts in your symptoms and your closeness to your brother cluster around the time of your mother's diagnosis.
clusters.change: The run included events from 1993 onward, but the heightened period sits around your mother's cancer diagnosis in 1995 and the shifts in your contact with family in its wake.
